notes: Making as a trade: seeing and drawing for work, the materials, the state's own craft traditions, showing the work, and the working artist's money and rights. Every check produces a real object, drawing or document. Stance: the traditions named here — the Mardi Gras Indian suit, Chitimacha basketry, the float den, the forge — belong to the communities and families who carry them; this pack teaches the craft with respect and sends the learner to those keepers, never around them.

themes.description: The long practice: the year's rhythm of making, showing, selling and resting.
themes.transfer_check: Write a one-year plan for a working art practice with income, making time and two shows, reviewed with a working artist.

bands.K–2: Ask an adult if art careers change as people get older.
bands.3–5: Learn that an art career can change over time, with an adult's help.
bands.6–8: Identify a real stage of a working artist's career, with a checker.
bands.9–10: Plan your own real long-term arts career across its seasons, on your own.
bands.11–12: Advise someone else on navigating the real seasons of an arts career.
